tools.name: start_research
tools.title: Start GPTResearcher Research
tools.description: Runs a GPT Researcher Python research task and returns the report, sources, costs, and collected context.

query.description: Research question to send to GPTResearcher.

context.description: Optional instructions or data for the research task. The query remains the main query used for web research.

reportType.description: GPT Researcher report type. Defaults to research_report.

workingDir.description: Optional working directory inside WORKSPACE_PATH. The final Markdown report is saved there. When useLocalDocs is true or omitted and local files exist, this directory is also exposed to GPTResearcher through DOC_PATH.

useLocalDocs.description: Whether GPTResearcher should use workingDir as local document context. Defaults to true, which uses hybrid research. False uses web-only research.

tools.name: gpt_researcher_get_settings
tools.title: Get GPTResearcher Settings
tools.description: Returns persisted GPT Researcher model settings.

tools.name: gpt_researcher_list_models
tools.title: List GPTResearcher Model Options
tools.description: Returns Soul Gateway model metadata for GPTResearcher settings.

fastLlm.description: Soul Gateway model id for FAST_LLM, without the soul_gateway: prefix.

smartLlm.description: Soul Gateway model id for SMART_LLM, without the soul_gateway: prefix.

strategicLlm.description: Soul Gateway model id for STRATEGIC_LLM, without the soul_gateway: prefix.

embedding.description: Soul Gateway embedding model id, without the soul_gateway: prefix.
